items.title: Data Breach at Texas Gas Station Operator Exposes Info of 377,000+ Customers

The breach, discovered on September 27, 2025, exposed sensitive data over 10 days from September 17 to September 27, 2025. items.title: Ireland recalls almost 13,000 passports over missing 'IRL' code
items.description: Ireland's Department of Foreign Affairs has recalled nearly 13,000 passports after a software update caused a printing defect. The printing error makes the documents non-compliant with international travel standards and potentially unreadable at automated border gates. [...]
